_comment: Who and where this place is. Shape: schemas/locale.toml. Operator decision 2026-09-15: Silverdale is the canonical world, not a reference dataset beside a generic one. Nothing in src/ or web/ may name this locale; it is selected by id, so adding a second town stays a data drop.
name: Silverdale
setting: Head of Dyes Inlet, an arm of Puget Sound, on the Kitsap Peninsula
centre_note: GNIS populated place 1512662. The census designated place centroid (2408740) is at 47.6664, -122.6828, uphill and north of the town itself.

state-fish-wildlife.name: Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife

state-health-biotoxin.name: Washington State Department of Health, Marine Biotoxins
state-health-biotoxin.note: Check before every shellfish harvest, not once. Cooking and freezing do not destroy paralytic shellfish poison. Hotline 1-800-562-5632.

state-noxious-weeds.name: Washington State Noxious Weed Control Board
state-noxious-weeds.note: Lists the county board contacts, including Kitsap.

state-water-agency.name: Washington State Department of Ecology, Water Rights
state-water-agency.note: WRIA 15 overrides the statewide groundwater permit exemption, so what you may legally draw here is not the statewide answer.

regional-air-agency.name: Puget Sound Clean Air Agency
regional-air-agency.note: Declares burn bans for King, Kitsap, Pierce and Snohomish counties. Check on the day you intend to burn, not once a season.

licence: Public domain. Every value in this file comes from a US federal source (17 U.S.C. 105) unless an entry says otherwise, so it may ship inside the release bundle. Nothing here was taken from Wikipedia, OpenStreetMap, GBIF or iNaturalist, whose share-alike terms would travel with every copy.
